name: MoneyBag
concept: The bank's cash sack of 1989 Everon: a tall grey-brown hessian sack of banknotes with rope wound round its gathered neck. A robber carries it out of the vault by the neck in one hand, sets it down, or throws it into the back of a van.
prompt: Canvas cash sack of a late-1980s Eastern-bloc bank: a lumpy bag stuffed with banknotes, a gathered neck tied with a drawstring or strap, and a plain stencilled panel or patch on the front. no text, no logos.
